sentences.text: For a Tier 3 UCB, the directions for loans sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 apply to this floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on 15 March 2026.
Yes: in cases other than paragraphs 261(1) and 261(2), any pre-payment charge, if levied, is as per the UCB's approved policy, and for a term loan it is based on the amount being prepaid.
The applicability of pre-payment charges must be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and no undisclosed pre-payment charges may be charged by a UCB.
